object.attr: analysis: a PDF of uncommitted edits carries the issue with no warning, so a draft passes for the issue (architecture review; CF-P12). Only files the on-disk format defines count, so temporary, backup and PDF files don't mark a clean export (failure analysis Q5, decided on 2026-11-11). Accepted only with MELLON-PDF-SRS-93 (review Q63).
object.description: When the document has an uncommitted document file, the cover page shall state that the exported PDF includes uncommitted changes.
